ideas.title: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the impact of the Trump Administration's freeze on funding.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How will the freeze on funding affect Medicaid recipients?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread corruption and highlight the need for increased oversight and regulation. By analyzing data and conducting interviews with key stakeholders, we can shed light on the impact of the Trump Administration's actions and the consequences for Medicaid recipients.
